games.headline: K9 Unit holds off Stroud and Proud in a 2.7-point thriller
article: K9 Unit beat Stroud and Proud 142.20 to 139.50 in Week 3, a nail-biter decided by 2.70 points.
Bijan Robinson carried K9 Unit with 34.3 points, 16.9 over his projection. Jordan Love (22.0) and Kenneth Walker III (20.3) chipped in.
For Stroud and Proud, Tyler Shough led the way with 31.6. The bigger story was TreVeyon Henderson, who managed 3.4 on a 9.7 projection.
K9 Unit left 17.40 points on the bench, with Kenyon Sadiq (20.0) sitting out.
At quarterback, Tyler Shough (31.6) outdueled Jordan Love (22.0).
K9 Unit moves to 2-1 (2nd place). Stroud and Proud falls to 1-2 (6th).
